title: Document tests/integration/ convention
description:
tests/integration/ now contains 3 files (branch-setup.test.mjs, merge-task.test.mjs, silent-infinite-loop-regression.test.mjs). Architect-reviewer flagged ARCH-N-016-9: the convention is now load-bearing — pattern: tmp-repo fixture via mkdtempSync, spawnSync(process.execPath, [SCRIPT_PATH, ...]) with cwd: tmpRoot, per-repo git config (no --global), livingDocs:[] suppression, JSON.parse(stdout) with stderr-attached error messages, rebuildCmd config in fixture .orchestrator.json, afterEach rmSync with EBUSY tolerance.

Write tests/integration/README.md (one-paragraph + checklist) so future integration tests don't reinvent the harness. Reference TASK-015 + TASK-016 as canonical examples.
acceptance_criteria: Documents the tmp-repo fixture pattern, spawnSync conventions, livingDocs:[] suppression, rebuildCmd usage, JSON envelope assertions, and EBUSY-tolerant cleanup
References merge-task.test.mjs and silent-infinite-loop-regression.test.mjs as canonical examples
Mentions the trade-off between subprocess (TASK-016) and hybrid (TASK-015) invocation strategies
